data.title: Wealthy Thais cut London buying and turn to Japan property
data.description: Thai investors are cutting London property budgets and shifting capital towards Tokyo and Niseko as UK uncertainty raises ownership costs

data.title: TSD portal breach tests trust in Thailand’s capital market
data.description: Thailand’s TSD data breach has put investor privacy under scrutiny, although securities trading, financial information and assets remain unaffected.

data.title: TSD blocks cyber threat after Investor Portal data leak
data.description: Thailand Securities Depository has contained a data leak on its Investor Portal and notified regulators and potentially affected users

data.title: Emerging markets drive global central bank gold buying in May
data.description: World Gold Council data show central banks added 41 tonnes of gold in May, with Poland leading purchases and China extending its buying run.

data.title: GROREIT moves to reclaim Royal Orchid asset after ROH misses buy-back deadline
data.description: ONE Asset Management says ROH has defaulted on its 4.873-billion-baht buy-back of the Royal Orchid Sheraton asset, ending its repurchase right and paving the way for valuation and a new auction.

data.title: Thai sellers cut prices on new and second-hand homes amid tight lending
data.description: Developers and resale sellers are lowering prices and adding incentives as weak purchasing power, high household debt and strict mortgage lending curb Thailand’s housing market.

data.title: Asian Exchanges Race to Capture Shift in Global Capital Jet Stream
data.description: As multi-trillion-dollar indices freeze new allocations to the US, Asian bourses deploy radical listings and governance reforms to capture the historic spillover of global wealth

data.title: Asia-Pacific finance shifts from AI spending to measurable value
data.description: Asia-Pacific banks are shifting from AI experiments to measurable returns as real-time finance grows, but skills shortages remain a critical barrier.

data.title: Retail giants turn mall revamps into Bangkok’s new property battleground
data.description: Thailand’s leading retail and property groups are investing billions of baht in mall revamps and mixed-use projects, turning ageing shopping centres into lifestyle, cultural and food landmarks as mass transit and rising land values reshape Bangkok’s key districts.

data.title: RESAM calls for new city plan to end mandatory parking for condos near rail stations
data.description: RESAM says scrapping compulsory parking requirements for condominiums near electric train stations could cut urban housing prices, encourage mass-transit use and support more affordable city living.

data.title: Top 5 rail-line land price rises revealed, Green Line Khu Khot-Lam Luk Ka leads
data.description: REIC data shows land prices along mass transit routes continued to climb in the second quarter of 2026, led by the Green Line extension from Khu Khot to Lam Luk Ka.
